import networkx as nx

edges = [(2,9), (0,10), (15,17), (12,15), (2,6), (3,17), (0,14), (11,13), (9,14), (6,12), (10,13), (1,10), (11,17), (10,16), (1,5), (6,14), (5,10), (1,9), (4,14), (15,16), (3,12), (13,16), (2,3), (10,15), (7,13), (6,16), (2,8), (3,10), (0,15), (2,16)]

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(18))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

print("Initial connectivity:", nx.node_connectivity(G))

# Add edges to make it 4-connected
import random
random.seed(42)

while nx.node_connectivity(G) < 4:
    u = random.randint(0, 17)
    v = random.randint(0, 17)
    if u != v and not G.has_edge(u, v):
        G.add_edge(u, v)

print("Final connectivity:", nx.node_connectivity(G))
print("Edges:", list(G.edges()))
